entities.summary:
The M74 Group is a small group of galaxies in the constellation Pisces. The face-on spiral galaxy M74 is the brightest galaxy within the group. Other members include the peculiar spiral galaxy NGC 660 and several smaller irregular galaxies
. The M74 Group is one of many galaxy groups that lie within the Virgo Supercluster.
